dsh-linked-folders is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Multi-folder workspace: a durable global linked-folders list plus per-session on-the-fly linking (link_folder/unlink_folder), managed from the Web sidebar with a native folder picker.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-5916686b6820bc7c4284.html
